- MODE files
build: A-04 offsets: the wiki gives no byte offsets
A-09 processing order: wiki does not say whether the file is pre-sorted
A-10 balance without account: wiki silent
A-12 update with zero interest, cycle reset: listed in builder flags.json
A-13 no DEFAULT row: BR-02 does not cover it
A-14 ten-year rule: leap-day and invalid dates not covered
A-18 AC 7 DECISION left as keep stub
cr_rule: A-14/A-15: reduction when openDate <= run date - 10 years (cutoff 2012-07-18 from interestRunDate), max(rate-2.00,0), applied before the rate != 0 test. Raises leap-day/invalid dates as not covered (R-INT-RATE flagged); builder flags.json does not list the ten-year rule.
